title: Compact ledger snapshot propagator for constrained-edge metering
creator: Marina Cortez
description: Design and implement a compact ledger snapshot propagator that generates and ships delta-compressed usage snapshots from regional edge collectors to the central billing ingest. Goals: reduce bandwidth and tail latency for constrained collectors, ensure idempotent apply at the central ledger, preserve per-request provenance, and support deterministic backfill/replay. This ticket covers producer-side compaction, protobuf schema v2 for compressed chunks, streaming checksum verification, and a lightweight reconciler at the central side to apply snapshots with conflict resolution metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Edge collectors produce compact snapshot chunks that are <= 50% of current uncompressed size for 95th percentile workload
Central ingest accepts and idempotently applies snapshot chunks with at-most-once semantics under duplicate deliveries
Snapshots include provenance metadata (source-region, collector-instance, sequence-range, cryptographic checksum) and pass end-to-end checksum validation in CI
Operator dashboard exposes per-collector snapshot lag, compressed size ratio, and apply success/failure rates
Automated backfill workflow can rehydrate missing intermediate snapshots from chunked deltas and produce a consistent ledger state for audit
technical_notes: Producer-side: implement chunked LMDB export from the in-memory collector buffer; serialize using protobuf v2 with delta encoding of token counts and run-length encoding for repeated session prefixes
Compression: use Zstd level 3 with optional Brotli fallback for low-memory collectors; choose by runtime feature flag per collector tier
Transport: use HTTP/2 streaming with GRPC-like headers; support resumable offsets via sequence_range and vector_clock to tolerate intermittent connections
Idempotency: each chunk carries a chunk_id computed as sha256(region||collector||seq_start||seq_end||salt) and central apply uses chunk_id dedupe table with 30-day TTL

Conflict resolution: central reconciler merges using last-write-by-sequence within a collector and cross-collector tie-breaker via deterministic collector_id priority map; plan includes a later cleanup pass to surface anomalies to billing ops
Schema evolution: include a semantic version field; decoders must ignore unknown fields and preserve raw bytes to enable offline forensic decoding
Observability: emit metrics: collector_snapshot_size_bytes, snapshot_compression_ratio, snapshot_apply_latency_ms, snapshot_apply_errors_total; traces must include collector_id and chunk_id
Backfill: implement a chunk reassembly service that can reconstruct missing ranges by replaying commit log and producing compacted snapshot chunks for retroactive ingestion
Testing: unit tests for encode/decode round trip; property tests for idempotency under reorder/duplicate; integration test against billing ingest test harness with simulated network partitions
